paragraphs.text: translated by
1. MAY benediction of the Gods approach us, holy, to aid us with all rapid succours.
paragraphs.original: आ नो देवानामुप वेतु शंसो विश्वेभिस्तुरैरवसे यजत्रः ।
paragraphs.translit: ā no devānāmupa vetu śaṃso viśvebhisturairavase yajatraḥ |

paragraphs.text: Therewith may we be happily befriended, and pass triumphant over all our troubles.
paragraphs.original: तेभिर्वयं सुषखायो भवेम तरन्तो विश्वा दुरिता स्याम
paragraphs.translit: tebhirvayaṃ suṣakhāyo bhavema taranto viśvā duritā syāma

paragraphs.text: 2. A man should think on wealth and strive to win it by adoration on the path of Order,
paragraphs.original: परि चिन्मर्तो द्रविणं ममन्यादृतस्य पथा नमसा विवासेत् ।
paragraphs.translit: pari cinmarto draviṇaṃ mamanyādṛtasya pathā namasā vivāset |

paragraphs.text: Counsel himself with his own mental insight, and grasp still nobler vigour with his spirit.
paragraphs.original: उत स्वेन क्रतुना सं वदेत श्रेयांसं दक्षं मनसा जगृभ्यात्
paragraphs.translit: uta svena kratunā saṃ vadeta śreyāṃsaṃ dakṣaṃ manasā jagṛbhyāt

paragraphs.text: 3. The hymn is formed, poured are the allotted portions: as to a ford friends come unto the Wondrous.
paragraphs.original: अधायि धीतिरससृग्रमंशास्तीर्थे न दस्ममुप यन्त्यूमाः ।
paragraphs.translit: adhāyi dhītirasasṛgramaṃśāstīrthe na dasmamupa yantyūmāḥ |

paragraphs.text: We have obtained the power of case and comfort, we have become acquainted, with Immortals.
paragraphs.original: अभ्यानश्म सुवितस्य शूषं नवेदसो अमृतानामभूम
paragraphs.translit: abhyānaśma suvitasya śūṣaṃ navedaso amṛtānāmabhūma

paragraphs.text: 4. Pleased be the Eternal Lord who loves the household with this man whom God Savitar created.
paragraphs.original: नित्यश्चाकन्यात्स्वपतिर्दमूना यस्मा उ देवः सविता जजान ।
paragraphs.translit: nityaścākanyātsvapatirdamūnā yasmā u devaḥ savitā jajāna |

paragraphs.text: May Bhaga Aryaman grace him with cattle: may he appear to him, and be, delightful.
paragraphs.original: भगो वा गोभिरर्यमेमनज्यात्सो अस्मै चारुश्छदयदुत स्यात्
paragraphs.translit: bhago vā gobhiraryamemanajyātso asmai cāruśchadayaduta syāt

paragraphs.text: 5. Like the Dawns' dwelling-place be this assembly, where in their might men rich in food have gathered.
paragraphs.original: इयं सा भूया उषसामिव क्षा यद्ध क्षुमन्तः शवसा समायन् ।
paragraphs.translit: iyaṃ sā bhūyā uṣasāmiva kṣā yaddha kṣumantaḥ śavasā samāyan |

paragraphs.text: Striving to share the praises of this singer. To us come strengthening and effectual riches!
paragraphs.original: अस्य स्तुतिं जरितुर्भिक्षमाणा आ नः शग्मास उप यन्तु वाजाः
paragraphs.translit: asya stutiṃ jariturbhikṣamāṇā ā naḥ śagmāsa upa yantu vājāḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. This Bull's most gracious far-extended favour existed first of all in full abundance.
paragraphs.original: अस्येदेषा सुमतिः पप्रथानाभवत्पूर्व्या भूमना गौः ।
paragraphs.translit: asyedeṣā sumatiḥ paprathānābhavatpūrvyā bhūmanā gauḥ |

paragraphs.text: By his support they are maintained in common who in the Asura's mansion dwell together.
paragraphs.original: अस्य सनीळा असुरस्य योनौ समान आ भरणे बिभ्रमाणाः
paragraphs.translit: asya sanīḷā asurasya yonau samāna ā bharaṇe bibhramāṇāḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. What was the tree, what wood, in sooth, produced it, from which they fashioned forth the Earth and Heaven?
paragraphs.original: किं स्विद्वनं क उ स वृक्ष आस यतो द्यावापृथिवी निष्टतक्षुः ।
paragraphs.translit: kiṃ svidvanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsa yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ |

paragraphs.text: These Twain stand fast and wax not old for ever: these have sung praise to many a day and morning.
paragraphs.original: संतस्थाने अजरे इतऊती अहानि पूर्वीरुषसो जरन्त
paragraphs.translit: saṃtasthāne ajare itaūtī ahāni pūrvīruṣaso jaranta

paragraphs.text: 8. Not only here is this: more is beyond us. He is the Bull, the Heaven's and Earth's supporter.
paragraphs.original: नैतावदेना परो अन्यदस्त्युक्षा स द्यावापृथिवी बिभर्ति ।
paragraphs.translit: naitāvadenā paro anyadastyukṣā sa dyāvāpṛthivī bibharti |

paragraphs.text: With power divine he makes his skin a filter, when the Bay Coursers bear him on as Surya.
paragraphs.original: त्वचं पवित्रं कृणुत स्वधावान्यदीं सूर्यं न हरितो वहन्ति
paragraphs.translit: tvacaṃ pavitraṃ kṛṇuta svadhāvānyadīṃ sūryaṃ na harito vahanti

paragraphs.text: 9. He passes o'er the broad earth like a Stega: he penetrates the world as Wind the mist-cloud.
paragraphs.original: स्तेगो न क्षामत्येति पृथ्वीं मिहं न वातो वि ह वाति भूम ।
paragraphs.translit: stego na kṣāmatyeti pṛthvīṃ mihaṃ na vāto vi ha vāti bhūma |

paragraphs.text: He, balmed with oil, near Varuna and Mitra, like Agni in the wood, hath shot forth splendour.
paragraphs.original: मित्रो यत्र वरुणो अज्यमानोऽग्निर्वने न व्यसृष्ट शोकम्
paragraphs.translit: mitro yatra varuṇo ajyamāno'gnirvane na vyasṛṣṭa śokam

paragraphs.text: 10. When suddenly called the cow that erst was barren, she, self-protected, ended all her troubles.
paragraphs.original: स्तरीर्यत्सूत सद्यो अज्यमाना व्यथिरव्यथीः कृणुत स्वगोपा ।
paragraphs.translit: starīryatsūta sadyo ajyamānā vyathiravyathīḥ kṛṇuta svagopā |

paragraphs.text: Earth, when the first son sprang from sire and mother, cast up the game, that which men were seeking.
paragraphs.original: पुत्रो यत्पूर्वः पित्रोर्जनिष्ट शम्यां गौर्जगार यद्ध पृच्छान्
paragraphs.translit: putro yatpūrvaḥ pitrorjaniṣṭa śamyāṃ gaurjagāra yaddha pṛcchān

paragraphs.text: 11. To Nrsad's son they gave the name of Kainva, and he the brown-hued courser won the treasure.
paragraphs.original: उत कण्वं नृषदः पुत्रमाहुरुत श्यावो धनमादत्त वाजी ।
paragraphs.translit: uta kaṇvaṃ nṛṣadaḥ putramāhuruta śyāvo dhanamādatta vājī |

paragraphs.text: For him dark-coloured streamed the shining udder: none made it swell for him. Thus Order willed it.
paragraphs.original: प्र कृष्णाय रुशदपिन्वतोधरृतमत्र नकिरस्मा अपीपेत्
paragraphs.translit: pra kṛṣṇāya ruśadapinvatodharṛtamatra nakirasmā apīpet
